# Supplier Evidence Validation

## Purpose

Avoid treating supplier statements, badges, or outdated reports as stronger assurance than they provide.

## Requirements

Supplier evidence SHOULD be evaluated for issuer/source, scope, period, recency, exceptions, applicability to the purchased service, and whether claims are independently verified or self-asserted.

A certification or report may reduce uncertainty but does not replace assessment of service-specific architecture, data use, contractual obligations, operational dependency, or known incidents where those are material.

See [Supplier Evidence Review SOP](../sop/SUPPLIER_EVIDENCE_REVIEW_SOP.md).
